## Purpose
Compact industry knowledge entries for BFSI, healthcare and a few cross-functional domains. Each is filed against a domain concept and retrieved into live prompts by walking the domain hierarchy.

## Settings that matter
- **Entry fields:** `concept` (a domain id), `kind`, `title`, `tags` and `body` (markdown). `as_of` is optional and appears in none of the 16 entries here.
- **`kind`** is one of definition, regulation, process, metric, risk, best_practice or glossary.
- **The 16 entries:**
  - `domain.bfsi`: regulation ("Core financial-services regulatory themes") and risk ("Common failure modes in financial decisioning");
  - `domain.lending`: process ("Credit decisioning pipeline") and a metric;
  - `domain.lending.mortgage` and `domain.lending.vehicle_finance`: a definition each;
  - `domain.insurance`: a process;
  - `domain.insurance.underwriting`: a definition;
  - `domain.insurance.claims`: a risk;
  - `domain.healthcare`: a regulation;
  - `domain.healthcare.clinical`: a process;
  - `domain.technology.security`: a risk;
  - `domain.retail.order_management`: a process;
  - `domain.legal.contracts`: a process;
  - `domain.customer_support` and `domain.compliance`: a best practice each.

## Read by
- `catalog/seed_loader._load_knowledge`, which upserts the entries after the concepts.
- Knowledge retrieval (`knowledge_context_layer` and the catalog knowledge lookups).

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **File a fact at the most general level it is true at.** Retrieval inherits both ways, so a rule for all lending goes on `domain.lending` and is not copied onto its subdomains.
- **Bodies are deliberately short,** because they are injected into prompts on every agent turn that touches them.
- **Tags are extra match terms,** written as the words people type.

## How to rebuild this file
Copy it verbatim from the source, including the header comment and all 16 entries. The bodies are prompt content the planner depends on.
